description.zh: 待更新ICP备案状态的加速域名。
description.en: The accelerated domain name whose ICP filing status you want to update.

description.zh: 全球加速实例所属的地域ID，仅取值：**cn-hangzhou**。
description.en: The ID of the region where the Global Accelerator (GA) instance is deployed. Set the value to **cn-hangzhou**.

descriptions.zh:
本接口用于获取加速域名最新ICP备案状态并进行更新。

**UpdateDomainState**接口不支持在同一个账号下并发更新加速域名的ICP备案状态。
descriptions.en:
This operation queries the latest ICP filing status of an accelerated domain name and updates the status accordingly.

The **UpdateDomainState** operation holds an exclusive lock on the GA instance. While the operation is in progress, you cannot call the same operation with the same Alibaba Cloud account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ga update-domain-state --domain www.example.com --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
